## Architecture Summary
- **Native C11 Core (`include/`, `src/`):** Zero third-party runtime dependencies; flat ABI `0x00010500` (`cellulogonic_abi.h`); 8 conserved molecular species (`S, X, M, E, L, P, T, W`), 19 balanced reactions (`R1`–`R15c`), 4 planetary solvents (`Terran H2O`, `Titan CH4/N2`, `Hydrothermal GDGT`, `Venus H2SO4`), exact `int64_t` `0 amu` mass & `0 uq` First-Law closure, strict `q_r > 0` Second Law, Canham–Helfrich vesicles (`Q = 100 V^2 / L^3`), serial primary/secondary endosymbiosis, Levin bioelectricity (`V_m`), Tardigrade TDP/CAHS bioglass anhydrobiosis, 3D off-lattice Taylor–Green Stokes hydrodynamics, classical stateful Fröhlich–Pokorný GHz microtubule ODE, and zero-blueprint translation-invariant 5-fate 3D clonal embryogenesis (Steinberg cadherins, apical constriction, Netrin/Slit axons + Hebbian pruning, Hippo/eutelic arrest, ATP-billed CPG waves).
- **Dual Kernels & Parity:** 256-bit AVX2 vectorized finite-volume diffusion (`v4i64`) and portable scalar C11 oracle produce 0-bit identical SHA-256 `681a9747e9f4caa110d88e3fe8995e685b397e3350f52ab1e8294c15519eceff` across Win64 PE64 (`clang 23.1.0 -Werror`) and Linux ELF64 (`gcc 13.3.0`) over 300 epochs (51,488 cell steps, 1,222,070 reactions, `0` drift, `0` post-warmup allocs, `ABI 0x00010500`).
- **Falsification, Mutants, Property Checks, Oracle, Web Tests & Fuzzing:** `test/test_falsification.c` passes `26/26` gates and catches `8/8` planted mutants (`M1`–`M8`); dual-mode `test/fuzz_cmbin_abi.c` passes `1,000/1,000` adversarial `"CMB5"` ABI/CMBIN fuzz cases (plus `libFuzzer` mode); `reference/chemoton_oracle.py` + `scripts/verify_oracle_and_stats.py` verify `6,586` exact-rational stoichiometry/Canham-Helfrich checks + differential 4-solvent parity; `scripts/prop_check.py` passes `2,700/2,700` randomized trials; `test/test_web_server.mjs` passes `12/12` HTTP/CSP/CSRF/DNS-rebinding tests.
- **Six-Kernel Pure Lean 4.35.0 Suite (`lean/`):** 70 audited theorems across 10 modules (`Spec.lean`, `StoichiometryThermo`, `MembraneGeometry`, `BioenergeticsEndosymbiosis`, `ChemiosmosisAutopoiesis`, `EutelicOrganogenesis`, `CytoskeletonNanomechanics`, `MorphogeneticGRN`, `ContinuumBiomechanics`, `NonVacuity`), `autoImplicit = false`, zero Mathlib, zero `sorry` in `Solution`, zero `native_decide`, axioms strictly within `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. Isolated `Challenge.lean` (445 lines, 19,487 bytes) imports only `Spec.lean`. Locally verified across `lean`, `leanchecker --fresh`, `leanchecker-paranoid --fresh`, `con-leche --verified`, `con-ron --verified`, and `nanoda_bin`; full 6/6 kernels (adding `lean4lean` + `lake check --paranoid` + `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid`) wired under `bubblewrap` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- **Empirical Highlights (`v1.5.0`):** Zero-seed abiogenesis (`0` -> `1,737` vesicles, peak `598` alive, `COVI = 89.49`); 5-fate 3D embryogenesis (`8` blastomeres -> `50` alive, `P=4, Ec=8, N=18, M=9, G=6, Gm=5`, `80.0%` peak sort, `328` wired / `292` pruned axons, `725` CPG pulses); de-novo 4-solvent adaptation (`90.8% / 66.7% / 94.5% / 87.1%`, Terran->Venus `59.7%`); locked `N = 24` paired stats (`96/96` wins across `H1`–`H4`, `p_Holm = 0.00040`, Cohen `dz` in `[1.47, 4.21]`).
- **White Paper:** `paper/main.tex` (`amsart`) compiles with Tectonic with `0` Overfull `\hbox`, `0` undefined refs/citations, `36/36` live-verified DOIs in `paper/refs.bib`, frozen `dist/Donahue_2026_cellulogonic_mecha.pdf`, and clean-room verified `dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz`.
